acceptance_criteria: A backup file is the profile export encrypted with AES-GCM under a PBKDF2-SHA-256 key from the caregiver's password (at least 8 characters, typed twice); nothing about the child is readable without the password; the file name has no name of the child (tested)
A wrong password or a changed file is refused in German and nothing is written; a file of another format or version is refused (tested)

Each profile card offers 'Sicherung speichern': a view that says what the file holds (including demo clips of adults), that it must be kept private, and that a lost password cannot be recovered; saving downloads the file (tested with an injected file saver)

The profile list offers 'Sicherung einspielen' also on a device without profiles: choose the file, type the password; a profile already on the device asks 'Ersetzen' or 'Als Kopie einspielen'; a restored profile becomes the active board when none is active (tested)
The caregiver texts no longer say that there is no backup; the product contract records the decision (tested)
A real-browser test saves and restores a synthetic profile with a demo clip through Web Crypto
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (owner decision in session 2026-11-25: backup 'Ja mit Passwort'; earlier: 'Alles mit ins Backup, sodass man das Gerät wechseln kann'; session approved)
goal: A caregiver saves a password-protected backup file of a profile (board, wording, pictures, taught gestures, demo clips) and restores it on another device, so a device can be replaced without losing data.
non_goals: No cloud, no sync, no upload: the file goes where the caregiver saves it
